exhaustive -h
stdout ^$
stderr -count=3 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^usage: exhaustive \[-B\] \[-casenil\] \[-d\] .+'
stderr -count=1 '\[-typeonly regexp\] \[packages\]$'

! exhaustive -invalid
stdout ^$
stderr -count=4 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^flag provided but not defined: -invalid$'
stderr -count=1 '^usage: exhaustive .+'

cd $WORK/example.com
! exhaustive -check='' example.com/foo
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^exhaustive: invalid value for flag -check: empty string$'

! exhaustive -check='switch,xyz' example.com/foo
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^exhaustive: invalid value for flag -check: unknown element "xyz"$'

! exhaustive -check='switch, typeswitch' example.com/foo
stderr -count=1 ^.
stderr -count=1 '^exhaustive: invalid value for flag -check: unknown element " typeswitch"$'

-- example.com/go.mod --
module example.com
go 1.26.0

-- example.com/foo/foo.go --
package foo
